page.running_head: Lib. 7. De communi scriptur. tractat. ratione.

main_text.p: Prima, vt de cuiusq; parte, siue quæstione, clarissima Mosis testimonia de ea re scrutentur, vt omnium fundamenta. Rom.2.18.20. Luc.16.29.31.& 24.27.Act.26.22.2.Tim.3.15.16.

Secunda,eorum interpretatio, siue illustratio per exempla, in historijs, per speciales applicationes, in prophetis,& psalmis,petenda est.Luc.24.44.& 24.27. Rom.4.3.7. Gal.3.6.7.8.10.11.12.13.16.17.18. Rom.9. 6,7.8.9.10.12.13.15.17.20.
Collatio specialis S Similium. scripturæ, est Dissimilium. Act.2.25.36.37.& 13.18.20.28.29 30.32.
Similium collatio, est præter eam quæ dicta est, ad sententias, & phrases similes, ex similibus illustrandas.Rom.10.20.21.1.Cor.15.25.27.1.Cor.4.19.20
Dissimilium, est earum quæ nisi conciliarentur, repugnarent.Mat.3.4.6.7.8.Act.9.22.

(a)Quare cum ex specie verborum,& sententiæ serie,quædam, vel analogiæ scripturæ, vel particularibus testimonijs quæ perspicua sunt, repugnare videntur :tum eis allatis, sensus repugnantiæ relinquendus & alius quærendus, (b) non consentiens modo cum reliquis omnibus scripturis, sed qui sit genuinus,hoc est, qui ex similiū collatione, præsentis scripturæ,cum partibus præcedentibus,& sequentibus, circumstantijs omnibus, totæ denique analysi, tum analogiæ, tum crypticæ, tum ad materiam logicæ, tum ad orationem, dialecticæ, & theoricæ, cōsentiat.(a) Luc.20.42.cum 1.Cor.15.25.27.(b)Act.25.36.Ga.3.10.16.17.He.12.27.Neh.8.9.1.1.Pet.1.20.

page.notes: Marginal fragments on the left edge belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Some words in the scan are blurred; "sententiæ" and "consentiat" read with some doubt. Catchword "Secundum" is printed in italic at the foot right.
